name: batch-14
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A dark-brown rectangular wooden abacus with a central divider, tan rods and ochre flattened oval beads. Preserve the icon's three visible rods, each with two beads above and five below the divider, and the small pale-gold corner fittings.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A cream felt-covered round ger shown with a low sloping roof, brown horizontal binding bands, a small terracotta-red roof ring and a teal door with a coral inset. Keep the felt surface, roof opening and compact cylindrical shelter form; no invented emblem or directional symbols.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A warm ochre dried gourd with a rounded bulbous base, narrow short neck and curved brown stem. Pale incised lines form the existing simple leaf-and-hill bands around its body; keep it a dry organic shell without added figures or lettering.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: One large translucent teal glass bead with a visible threading hole, two warm-gold curved decorative bands and soft glass highlights, threaded on a thin tan cord beside one small coral bead. Keep the hole and glass identity rather than turning the main bead into clay.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A painted bamboo balancing dragonfly with four long wings: the upper pair muted teal and the lower pair ochre, two pale-gold round eyes and a slender coral body and tail. Its pointed beak balances on a thin brown upright twig above a small grey-green support.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A rectangular cream sheet above a shallow brown tray, carrying broad flowing teal marbling with thinner coral swirls. A slender tan marbling tool lies diagonally across it; retain abstract fluid lines and no writing or new pictorial motifs.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A pale golden-bamboo rectangular frame holding two hollow bamboo tubes of different lengths, one straw-yellow and one olive-green. Preserve the open tube mouths, small suspension ties, visible bamboo nodes and lower horizontal support rail.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A teal swallow-shaped paper kite with broad pointed wings, a forked tail, coral central body and simple pale-gold structural lines. A single fine cream string curls below; keep the cut-paper silhouette and original sparse color blocks without copied motifs.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: An original flat coral paper bird puppet with one jointed teal wing and two slender brown control rods in front of a warm cream screen in a brown rectangular frame. A soft offset bird shadow is visible on the screen; no human figure, leather substitution or lettering.
